AnalyticsValue.description:
One analyzer metric. ``value`` is in ``unit`` (dollars, contracts or seconds); ``unit`` is
None for a plugin's metric the catalog does not know.
AnalyticsValue.title: AnalyticsValue

Bar.description:
One candle. ``source=trades`` bars carry ``trades``; ``source=ticker`` bars carry the
last quote, open interest and ``ticks``.
Bar.title: Bar

Gap.description:
A period the live stream may have missed (tickers, lifecycle events and orderbook
changes; trades are recovered, see ``trades_recovered``).
Gap.title: Gap

LayoutBody.description: What the page sends to save a layout: any JSON object (the front end defines it).
LayoutBody.title: LayoutBody

Limits.description: The limits from ``risk.toml`` that apply to this session (all decimal strings).
Limits.title: Limits

Opportunity.description:
An event whose YES bids sum to more than $1. ``profit`` is after Kalshi's taker fees and
is often negative; this is an indication from stored quotes (see ``oldest_quote_age_seconds``),
to be confirmed against the live book before trading.
Opportunity.title: Opportunity

OrderBook.description:
The book at ``as_of``. ``complete`` is false when the stored changes cannot be trusted to
be gap-free; ``gaps`` says why.
OrderBook.title: OrderBook

PreparedView.description: What would happen. ``prepare_id`` is null when the order is refused (nothing to execute).
PreparedView.title: PreparedView

get.description: Is a server configured, and does it answer? Never fails: the browser shows the answer.

schema.title: Response Touch Api Session Touch Post

post.description: Halt and cancel everything. Works with trading switched off too.
